$$
\pi_{i,j}+\pi_{a+1-j,a+1-i}=c
$$

for all $1\leq i,j\leq a$ with $i\neq j$. Let $\operatorname{qtcpp}_2(a,c)$ denote the number of QTC2 plane partitions, and let $p_a(c)$ be a polynomial in $\mathbb{Q}[c]$. **QTC2 enumeration conjecture.** For $a\geq2$,

$$
\operatorname{qtcpp}_2\left(a,c-\frac{a}{2}\right)=\begin{cases}
c\binom{c+\frac{a}{2}-1}{a-1}p_a(c)&a\text{ is even},\\
\binom{c+\frac{a}{2}-1}{a-1}p_a(c)&a\text{ is odd}.
\end{cases}
$$

    "canonical_url": "https://mathdb.com/p/359840/fractional-covering-conjecture-for-looms",
    "literal_statement": "Let $A$ and $B$ be hypergraphs forming an $(r,s)$-loom, and write $\mathbb{L}=(A,B)$. Define the fractional covering number of the loom by

$$
\tau^*(\mathbb{L})=\tau^*(A\cup B).
$$

Here $\tau^*$ is the minimum total weight of a nonnegative fractional vertex cover.

**Loom fractional covering conjecture.** If $\mathbb{L}=(A,B)$ is an $(r,s)$-loom, then

$$
\tau^*(\mathbb{L})=\max(r,s).
$$

The source has the upper bound $\tau^*(\mathbb{L})\leqslant\max(r,s)$ and proposes equality; it also notes that this conjecture would imply the Gyárfás–Lehel conjecture in the equal-uniformity setting. It remains open.",
